text: 莫彼得医生的助手，库戈尔。
source_text: 莫彼得医生的助手，库戈尔。

text: I need to see the Doc.
source_text: I need to see the Doc.

text: You need to talk to my man, Flash, here. He can help you out.
source_text: You need to talk to my man, Flash, here. He can help you out.

text: 你应该和我的哥们弗莱士谈一谈，他会帮你的。
source_text: 你应该和我的哥们弗莱士谈一谈，他会帮你的。

text: Yow! Don't talk too fast man. You give the Cougar a headhurt.# Talk to Flash instead.
source_text:
Yow! Don't talk too fast man. You give the Cougar a headhurt.
# Talk to Flash instead.

text: 喂，别说那么快，你的语速让我头疼。去和弗莱士说吧。
source_text: 喂，别说那么快，你的语速让我头疼。去和弗莱士说吧。

text: It's you, again. The Cougar got nothing more to say.
source_text: It's you, again. The Cougar got nothing more to say.

text: 又是你。我没什么话和你讲了。
source_text: 又是你。我没什么话和你讲了。

text: The Cougar is watching you, man!
source_text: The Cougar is watching you, man!

text: Nice outfit, you scavenge that yourself?
